issuing_body: U.S. District Court, District of Minnesota; publicly hosted by U.S. Department of Justice
title: United States v. Haji Osman Salad et al. — Indictment, ECF No. 1
notes: Original 39-page ECF No. 1 indictment. The official DOJ-hosted PDF was directly readable in this pass and its first page was visually checked. The caption identifies Doc. 1 filed 2022-09-13 and lists the face statutes.
supports: The indictment names Haji Osman Salad, Fahad Nur, Anab Artan Awad, Sharmarke Issa, and Farhiya Mohamud.
The face of the original indictment lists 18 U.S.C. §§ 1343, 1956, and 1957.
The original indictment charges substantive wire fraud and money-laundering offenses; it does not charge a wire-fraud conspiracy under either § 371 or § 1349.
The indictment alleges a scheme involving at least approximately $25 million in Federal Child Nutrition Program funds.
does_not_support: A network-wide conclusion about § 1349 in other Feeding Our Future charging instruments.
Adjudicated guilt; these are charging allegations.
